meta.name: finishing-a-development-branch
meta.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work

copy.tagline: 帮你决定开发分支的集成方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成功能开发并准备把代码合并到主分支
copy.tagline_en: Decide how to integrate your completed development work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have finished implementing a feature and need to merge your branch

howto.what: 收尾开发分支时,Claude 会先运行完整测试,通过后检测仓库类型,再给你「合并回主分支」「推送并创建 PR」「保留分支」等选项,由你选择;选择合并则执行并清理,丢弃改动必须获得你明确确认。
howto.when: 当开发已完成、测试全部通过,需要决定如何把改动整合进主分支时触发;例如你说「代码写完了,测试过了」或要求合并分支、创建 PR 时。

say.text: 代码写完了,测试都通过了,帮我收尾这个分支。
say.note: 它会先跑测试,再列出合并或建 PR 的选项。

say.text: 把这个分支合并回主分支。
say.note: 会先确认基础分支,合并后跑测试并清理。

say.text: 帮我把这个分支推送上去并创建 PR。
say.note: 会推送分支并给出 PR 链接。

howto.what_en: When finishing a development branch, Claude runs tests, detects repo type, then presents a menu: merge locally, create a PR, or keep the branch. Merging cleans up; discarding requires explicit typed confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementation is complete, tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work — e.g., saying you're done, asking to merge or create a PR.

say_en.text: The code is done and tests pass. Please finish this branch.
say_en.note: It runs tests first, then shows merge/PR options.

say_en.text: Merge this branch back into the main branch.
say_en.note: It confirms the base, merges, retests, and cleans up.

say_en.text: Push this branch and open a pull request.
say_en.note: It pushes and shares the PR link.
